name: JM Build Intake v0.1 — Intake-First Fail-Closed Proof Receipt
purpose: Prove that serious-build intake can recover current Estate candidates before implementation, remain fail-closed while route selection/gap analysis is unresolved, and open the existing Build Entry Gate only after explicit evidence-based authorization.

automatic_recovery_sources: current tracked executable-body paths under policy executable roots
implementation.candidate_boundary: Recovered matches are RECOVERY_CANDIDATE_ONLY and cannot become donor/source authority merely because the intake ranked them.
implementation.gate_requirement: For future high-confidence serious bodies, state.build_authorized_by_manifest must be true on the same-PR prospective manifest.

live_recovery_proof.meaning: The actual CI checkout searched current Estate material and recovered manifest-backed candidate references while preserving AUTHORIZED=false by default.

sequence.evidence: Prospective intake manifest existed before the executable fixture and was bound to PR 144 with build_authorized_by_manifest=false.

sequence.observed: ERROR: same-PR prospective intake exists but is not build-authorized
sequence.meaning: The gate distinguished an existing unresolved intake from a missing intake and refused to treat paperwork presence as authorization.

sequence.observed: PASS: serious build entry has same-PR authorized prospective manifest
sequence.meaning: Only the route manifest changed; the executable fixture remained unchanged.

proof_result: PASS — INTAKE FIRST -> UNRESOLVED RED -> ROUTE RESOLUTION -> SAME BODY GREEN
non_claims: This proof does not claim runtime quality, user contact, packaging, APK readiness or crown status.
Automatic recovery candidates are not automatically donors, sources, authorities or reuse decisions.
A structural Build Route Manifest PASS is not runtime/contact proof.
The disposable PR 144 fixture is not an Estate product and was not merged.

accidental_placeholder.meaning: Recorded for trace completeness; it was caught immediately and did not become a keeper, route authority or proof input.

governing_result: Serious JM builds can now enter through Estate recovery automatically. Intake evidence reduces operator burden, but native gates remain authoritative and unresolved recovery cannot be papered over into a green build.
